note: Private campground in an oak woods by Dodge Lake near Harrison, with a pond; 30 full hook-up and 20 'modern' (water/electric) sites per its Pure Michigan listing. No website of its own (the old domain is for sale); phone from its Google listing. --Claude
summary: No operator website: dodgecitycampground.com redirects to a domain-for-sale page. The Pure Michigan listing (operator's text) gives 50 sites, 30 full hook-up and 20 modern, operating spring-fall, and the same phone; recorded as reported. Google Maps: 'Dodge City Campground LLC', 2650 Dodge Lake Rd, Harrison, 4.6 stars from 62 reviews, phone 989-928-4331 (matches) - presence met on the Google path. No rate posted anywhere (RV Life $ tier only). Cleared the unsupported 'by reservation'. Note cleaned of the 'Transient family park, by reservation' claim no page supports.
flags: Missing website: the operator has no website or booking page (dodgecitycampground.com is expired and for sale, read 2026-10-22). Presence met only via Google Maps: 'Dodge City Campground LLC', 4.6 stars / 62 reviews, phone 989-928-4331.
No posted 2024+ rate from the operator; price indicator is RV Life's $ tier only. Seasonal share unknown (no page says whether it sells seasonal sites).
